description: This file contains C source code implementing functions related to repository pack file geometry calculations, including initialization, splitting, preferred pack selection, and redundancy removal for pack files in a version control system.

methods.name: uint32_t pack_geometry_weight(struct packed_git * p)
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a pack file, representing the number of objects it contains.

methods.name: int pack_geometry_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
methods.description: Comparator function used to sort pack files based on their weight.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_init(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct existing_packs * existing,const struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry structure by selecting relevant pack files, filtering based on criteria like local status, kept packs, cruft, and promisor status, and sorting them.

methods.name: uint32_t compute_pack_geometry_split(struct packed_git ** pack,size_t pack_nr,int split_factor)
methods.description: Determines the split index within a set of pack files based on size progression, used to optimize pack splitting.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Computes the split point for pack files based on their sizes and the split factor.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Identifies the preferred pack among a set of packs based on the largest pack above the split line.

methods.name: void remove_redundant_packs(struct packed_git ** pack,uint32_t pack_nr,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files from the repository based on specified criteria such as pack names and existing kept packs.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from both regular and promisor pack arrays within the pack geometry.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the pack and promisor pack arrays.
